provides.description: The native scenes of a Bevy game: load(scene), show(scene), unload(scene), setVisible(scene, visible), setInert(scene, inert), state(scene), inert(scene), progress(scene). Answers the scene orders of game.engine (game.engine.scene.*) and tells it the scenes the game puts in (game.engine.scenes.nativeEntered / nativeLeft).

listens.description: A scene starts loading (payload to): load(to).
A scene is entered (payload scene): load(scene), then show(scene) once loaded.
A scene is unloaded (payload scene, kept): unload(scene) unless kept.
The state of a loaded scene, game.engine's (payload scene, visible, paused): setVisible(scene, visible), then setInert(scene, paused).
A load failed and game.engine retries (payload scene, action retry): load(scene) again.

core.scene.description: The native scenes of a Bevy game, loaded in the background by the engine's own asset server. Each method can be served by the game in its language (provide_<method>); a reading answers typed, in place.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads the native scene of the scene document scene (its native path) and its models in the background, without showing it; a scene the game already put in is only observed. Progress goes to game.engine (game.engine.scenes.report, then game.engine.scene.progress).

methods.name: show
methods.description: Spawns scene in the current scene of the engine once it is loaded (at once when it already is), freeing the scene of the kits it replaces.

methods.name: unload
methods.description: Frees what core.scene spawned and loaded for scene; a scene the game put in is left as the game made it.

methods.name: setVisible
methods.description: Hides or shows again a scene core.scene spawned (a scene kept below another).

methods.name: setInert
methods.description: Makes a loaded scene inert (it stays loaded, visible or not, and no longer runs: no logic, physics, input nor animation) or wakes it without reloading. On Bevy: the marker InertScene on its entities (Without<InertScene> in the game's systems), its AnimationPlayers paused, and Bevy's Disabled when it is hidden as well. game.engine's paused (game.engine.scene.state) is this state.

methods.name: state
methods.description: Where scene stands: idle, loading, ready (loaded, not shown), shown, observed (put in by the game), failed.

methods.name: progress
methods.description: How far the load of scene is, 0 to 1 (Bevy tells only under way or loaded: 0 or 1).

methods.name: debug
methods.description: What the debugger shows of the native scenes (debug.expose@1): each scene with its state, visible and inert, the scenes of the game observed, the current one. JSON, read by debug.inspector only (an open panel, a snapshot). On the blank player the presentation module pushes the same entry instead (debug.inspector.publish).

expose.label: Native scenes
expose.description: The native scenes and their states, the loadings under way: read through core.scene.debug on Bevy native, pushed by the presentation module on the blank player (debug.inspector.publish), only while the debugger looks.
